female.sp: RGM-89D-ESC Jegan D Type (Escort Type) from Mobile Suit Gundam Narrative. The attached model-kit photographs are authoritative mechanical design references: the front view controls armor, weapon and shield geometry, while the rear view controls the backpack. Preserve the military-brown and dark-olive armor palette, rounded helmet-like head with a continuous magenta-red visor band and no V-fin, broad rectangular shoulder armor with black inset vents, added blocky chest armor with multiple horizontal black slats, muted taupe abdominal and foot accents, and the small yellow V on the burgundy front-waist panel. Preserve the standard Jegan backpack with TWO tall rectangular vertical thruster pylons above the shoulders, a compact central block and THREE downward bell-shaped thruster nozzles. Mount the single large elongated dark shield on her LEFT forearm, including the recessed missile ports near its upper section. Her RIGHT hand holds exactly one compact 90mm short machine gun with its forward vertical grip. Keep the beam-saber rack on the RIGHT waist and THREE hand grenades on the LEFT waist; do not duplicate any weapon, shield or backpack part. Keep both substantial shoulder plates, both forearm guards and the bell-shaped calf armor mechanically intact. The open fitted armor may leave the collarbones, narrow waist sides and controlled upper-thigh gaps visible between plates, without removing the shoulder armor or changing the core equipment. Her human face is fully visible with exactly two natural red eyes; do not replace her face with a Gundam mask or opaque visor. Translate the visor identity into a narrow red sensor-brow ornament and rounded helmet-like side frames around, not across, the face. Keep both backpack pylons, all three nozzles, the complete shield, the gun, head and feet fully inside the vertical frame. No text, logos, unit numbers, watermark or pilot resemblance.
